n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

MAXN = 510
C = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
f = [0] * (MAXN)
g = [0] * (MAXN)
dp = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
dp2 = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]

# Compute binomial coefficients
for i in range(n + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(i):
        C[i][j + 1] = (C[i - 1][j + 1] + C[i - 1][j]) % mod

f[0] = 1
g[0] = 0

# Calculate f and g
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 2):
        temp = C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1) % mod
        f[i] = (f[i] + temp * f[j - 1] * f[i - j] % mod) % mod

        t1 = C[i - 1][j - 1] * (i + 1) % mod
        t2 = (f[j - 1] * g[i - j] + g[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + t1 * t2) % mod

        add = C[i - 1][j - 1] * (((j - 1) * j // 2) + ((i - j + 1) * (i - j) // 2)) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + add * f[j - 1] * f[i - j]) % mod

n += 1

# Initialize DP arrays
for i in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(m + 1):
        dp[i][j] = 0
        dp2[i][j] = 0

dp[0][0] = 1
dp2[0][0] = 0

# Dynamic programming to compute the result
for i in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(m + 1):
        for k in range(0, m - j + 1):
            if i + k + 1 <= n:
                c = C[j + k][j]
                val1 = (dp[i][j] * f[k]) % mod
                val2 = (dp2[i][j] * c) % mod
                val3 = (dp[i][j] * g[k]) % mod
                sum2 = (val2 + val3) % mod
                new_dp = (dp[i][j] * f[k] * c) % mod
                new_dp2 = (sum2 * c) % mod
                dp[i + k + 1][j + k] = (dp[i + k + 1][j + k] + new_dp) % mod
                dp2[i + k + 1][j + k] = (dp2[i + k + 1][j + k] + new_dp2) % mod

print(dp2[n][m])
